answer_1.quote: Code generation automatically generates programs for the natural language (NL) requirement.

answer_2.quote: Following previous works , we use the pass rate as the metric, where we treat the generated program correctly only if its output is consistent with all ground truths of the test suite.

answer_4.quote: The evaluation is conducted on the numpyml subset of CODEAGENTBENCH manually by an experienced Python developer.
answer_4.guideline: The evaluation compares the number of solved problems on different products and our CODEAGENT, with human running solutions to identify and fix execution bugs and ensure functional correctness via test suite execution.
